title: Search - Pill
description: Rounded pill wrapper for the Blog All Articles search box. Only overrides what `styles/presets/blocks/core-search.json` (the site-wide core/search default) doesn't already set — that file already provides fontSize:200, the button's own radius/margin, and the button-inside border removal, so none of that is repeated here. This variation only adds a border/background/radius to the block's own wrapper, which the base preset leaves unstyled.
